name: MindTrace Diagnostic Agent
description: Agent orchestrator for forensic exam diagnosis, math verification, and learning gap remediation

subagents.name: exam-parser
subagents.task: Extract questions, student answers, and expected answers from documents using OCR & document understanding.

subagents.name: answer-evaluator
subagents.task: Perform deterministic SymPy verification on mathematical answers and isolate divergence points.

subagents.name: error-classifier
subagents.task: Classify student mistakes into structured error taxonomy (Sign, Factorization, Procedural, Calculation).

subagents.name: concept-analyzer
subagents.task: Map questions to concept graph nodes and index embeddings using MiniLM and FAISS.

subagents.name: root-cause-analyzer
subagents.task: Perform prerequisite graph traversal to infer root learning gaps and diagnostic confidence.

subagents.name: practice-generator
subagents.task: Generate targeted adaptive practice sets targeting specific error categories.

subagents.name: retest-verifier
subagents.task: Generate unseen conceptually similar re-tests and measure post-intervention mastery recovery.
